name: Zsper
description: Zsper is the AI writing partner with memory, made for founders and creators — it learns how you think and writes articles, newsletters, and LinkedIn posts that sound like you.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zsper to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zsper to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://zsper.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zsper MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zsper provides these MCP tools: fetch, get_brand_voice, list_recent_articles, search, search_articles, search_memory, save_learning, and save_draft.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zsper?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Zsper in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Zsper requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zsper is developed by Ruchit Suthar. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
